body:
## Problem

Every package this meta-package depends on declares `"postinstall": "node scripts/postinstall.cjs"`. Current package managers no longer run dependency lifecycle scripts by default. pnpm 12 turns the ignored script into a hard install error (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`), so adding or installing `@ivuorinen/base-configs` fails outright; Yarn 4 skips the scripts silently, so none of the starter config files the individual READMEs promise is ever written.

## Evidence

Consumer installs in empty scratch projects (npm 11.19.0, pnpm 12.4.1, Yarn 4.18.0, Node 24.21.0):

```text
$ pnpm add -D @ivuorinen/base-configs
exit 1
Error: ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS
  ╰─▶ Ignored build scripts: @ivuorinen/browserslist-config 1.3.22, @ivuorinen/commitlint-config 2.0.2,
      @ivuorinen/eslint-config 1.5.17, @ivuorinen/markdownlint-config 1.3.12, @ivuorinen/prettier-config 2.0.12,
      @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config 2.1.0, @ivuorinen/stylelint-config ...

$ CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile     # same project, lockfile present
exit 1  ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS

$ pnpm add -D prettier                       # control: no build script
exit 0
```

Yarn 4: `YN0004: … lists build scripts, but all build scripts have been disabled.` — exit 0, no config file created. npm 11.19: still runs the script but warns `install-scripts not yet covered by allowScripts`.

## Impact

Every pnpm 12 consumer's install — including CI with a frozen lockfile — fails until they discover `pnpm approve-builds` or `onlyBuiltDependencies`. Yarn 4 consumers get no configs and no error, so their tools run on defaults while they believe the shared config is active.

## Fix

The root cause and fix live in each config package (see the matching findings in the seven `base-configs-*` repos): stop relying on `postinstall` — ship an explicit init command (e.g. a `bin` such as `npx @ivuorinen/prettier-config init`) and document it. Until then, document in this README that pnpm users must add the seven packages to `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies` (or run `pnpm approve-builds`) and that Yarn 4 users must create the config files by hand.

## Resolution
Owner chose the document-only fix. README now states the Node floor and how each package manager treats the configs' postinstall: npm runs it, Yarn 4 does not, pnpm fails until approved. The pnpm instruction was verified on pnpm 12.4.1: `pnpm approve-builds --all` writes an `allowBuilds` map to pnpm-workspace.yaml, after which `CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0 (the `onlyBuiltDependencies` key no longer works on pnpm 12 and is not documented). Root cause stays in each config package by owner decision.
title: Installing base-configs with pnpm 12 fails: all seven configs ship an unapproved postinstall

body:
## Problem

Declared-surface drift. `package.json` declares `"engines": { "node": ">=20" }`, but the production dependency closure this meta-package exists to deliver cannot run on most of that range. Every Node 20 release and every Node 22 release before 22.19.0 is excluded by at least one dependency's own `engines` field, as is Node 24 before 24.10.0.

## Evidence

Fresh `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build` of the committed `package.json` + `yarn.lock`, then every package in the `dependencies` closure (723 packages) checked against candidate Node versions with `semver.satisfies`:

```text
versions satisfying the whole closure: 22.19.0, 22.22.2, 24.10.0, 24.15.0, 26.0.0
node 20.20.2 blocked by: @ivuorinen/commitlint-config 2.0.0 (>=22.12.0); @commitlint/config-conventional 21.2.2 (>=22.12.0); markdownlint-cli 0.49.0 (>=22); @semantic-release/github 12.0.8 (^22.14.0 || >= 24.10.0)
node 22.12.0 blocked by: eslint 10.5.0 (^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24); @semantic-release/github 12.0.8 (^22.14.0 || >= 24.10.0)
node 22.14.0 blocked by: undici 8.10.0 (>=22.19.0)
node 24.10.0 blocked by: nothing
```

`yarn.lock` resolves `@ivuorinen/commitlint-config` to 2.0.0 via 721b4ee (#569), released as base-configs v4.0.0 without touching `engines`.

## Impact

A consumer on Node 20.x, 22.0-22.18 or 24.0-24.9 is told by the manifest that it is supported, installs without a hard error (Yarn ignores engines; npm only warns `EBADENGINE`), and then runs commitlint, semantic-release and markdownlint versions that do not support that runtime.

## Fix

Set `"engines": { "node": "^22.19.0 || >=24.10.0" }` — the intersection of the dependencies' own floors — and say in the next release notes that the effective floor already rose in v4.0.0.

## Resolution
Owner chose (s)pec: engines.node set to "^22.19.0 || >=24.10.0"; README and CLAUDE.md state the same floor.
title: engines promises Node >=20 but the bundled toolchain needs ^22.19.0 || >=24.10.0

body:
## Problem

Dependency vulnerability. `yarn.lock` resolves `smol-toml` 1.6.1, affected by GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2 / CVE-2026-85730 (High, fixed in 1.7.1).

## Evidence

Detected by osv-scanner 2.6.0 (`GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2`, HIGH), grype 0.118.0 (`High`, fix `1.7.1`) and `yarn npm audit --all --recursive` (advisory 1193945, `vulnerable: <=1.7.0`, tree version `1.6.1`).

The same advisory fails MegaLinter's osv-scanner and trivy steps in the `Lint` job of `publish.yml`: `gh run view 33985615249` shows `❌ REPOSITORY | osv-scanner | … | 1 error` and `❌ REPOSITORY | trivy | … | 1 error`. `Publish` has `needs: [Linter]`, and the last three `main` runs (cf52ed7, cdeafcc, 6ee9ca2) are all `failure`.

## Impact

Beyond the vulnerable parser in the dev/CI tree, the advisory currently blocks the release pipeline: nothing merged since cf52ed7 publishes until the lockfile is fixed.

## Fix

Raise the resolution and refresh the lockfile:

```sh
yarn up -R smol-toml
```

If the parent's range caps it below 1.7.1, add `"smol-toml": "^1.7.1"` to `resolutions`, then `yarn install`. Re-run `osv-scanner scan source --lockfile=yarn.lock` to confirm.

## Resolution
smol-toml was pinned ~1.6.1 by markdownlint-cli 0.49.0. `yarn up -R @ivuorinen/markdownlint-config` moved it within the declared ^1.1.3 range to 1.3.12 (markdownlint-cli 0.49.1), resolving smol-toml 1.7.2. osv-scanner: No issues found.
title: smol-toml 1.6.1 is vulnerable to GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2 (High) and blocks every release

body:
## Problem

`package.json` runs `./node_modules/.bin/commitlint` (script `commitlint`, line 42) and `.simple-git-hooks.json` wires it as the `commit-msg` hook, but no manifest declares `@commitlint/cli`. It used to arrive transitively through `@ivuorinen/commitlint-config` 1.x. Commit 721b4ee (#569, `chore(deps)!: update dependency @ivuorinen/commitlint-config (1.0.32 → 2.0.0)`) moved to 2.0.0, which declares `@commitlint/cli` only as an optional peer, so nothing installs it any more.

## Evidence

```text
$ grep -c '^"@commitlint/cli@' yarn.lock
0
```

Fresh `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build` of the committed `package.json` + `yarn.lock` in a scratch directory:

```text
node_modules/.bin/commitlint: MISSING
$ printf 'feat: test\n' > msg; yarn commitlint --edit msg
exit 127
```

This clone still works only because its `node_modules` predates the bump (it holds `@ivuorinen/commitlint-config` 1.0.32 while the lockfile pins 2.0.0).

Separately, Yarn 4.18 defaults `enableScripts: false` (`yarn config get enableScripts` → `false`; a probe install logs `YN0004: simple-git-hooks lists build scripts, but all build scripts have been disabled`), so `simple-git-hooks`' own postinstall never writes `.git/hooks/commit-msg` on a fresh clone either. `CLAUDE.md` states commit messages are "enforced by commitlint via a simple-git-hooks commit-msg hook".

## Impact

Two failure modes, both silent until hit. A clone that already has the hook installed aborts every `git commit` with exit 127 after its next clean install. A fresh clone never gets the hook, so Conventional Commits — which decide this package's semver bump through semantic-release — are not checked locally at all, contrary to CLAUDE.md.

## Fix

Declare the CLI the hook runs and install the hook explicitly:

```json
"devDependencies": {
  "@commitlint/cli": "^21.2.3",
  ...
},
"scripts": {
  "prepare": "simple-git-hooks",
  ...
}
```

Then `yarn install` to update `yarn.lock`, and run `yarn simple-git-hooks` once in existing clones. Root `prepare` runs even with `enableScripts: false` because it is the project's own script, not a dependency's.

## Resolution
Declared "@commitlint/cli": "^21.2.3" in devDependencies. Fresh-clone simulation (committed package.json + yarn.lock, `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build`): commitlint bin present; after `yarn simple-git-hooks`, `git commit -m 'bad message'` exits 1 and `git commit -m 'feat: good'` exits 0. The finding's suggested `prepare` script was wrong: Yarn 4 does not run root `prepare` on install (verified), and a root `postinstall` would also run in npm consumers where simple-git-hooks is absent. CLAUDE.md now documents the one-time `yarn simple-git-hooks` step instead.
title: commitlint CLI is undeclared, so the commit-msg hook exits 127 or is never installed

body:
## Problem

`publish.yml:86-89` passes `extra_plugins: @semantic-release/changelog @semantic-release/github @semantic-release/npm` to `cycjimmy/semantic-release-action`. The action installs these with `npm install` at run time, unversioned — the latest tag at that moment, with npm lifecycle scripts enabled — inside the job that holds `secrets.PAT` and `id-token: write`. None of them is needed: `.releaserc.json` extends `@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config`, whose plugin chain is commit-analyzer, release-notes-generator, npm and github (all shipped inside `semantic-release` itself), and `@semantic-release/changelog` appears in no config at all.

## Evidence

```yaml
# .github/workflows/publish.yml:83-91
      - name: Semantic Release
        uses: cycjimmy/semantic-release-action@b12c8f6015dc215fe37bc154d4ad456dd3833c90 # v6.0.0
        with:
          extra_plugins: |
            @semantic-release/changelog
            @semantic-release/github
            @semantic-release/npm
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
```

`base-configs-semantic-release/index.cjs` plugins: `@semantic-release/commit-analyzer`, `@semantic-release/release-notes-generator`, `@semantic-release/npm`, `@semantic-release/github`. No repo in the workspace lists `@semantic-release/changelog` in a release config. None of the sibling repos' `publish.yml` passes `extra_plugins`.

## Impact

Every release executes whatever versions of three packages npm serves that minute, with install scripts, in a job that can mint an OIDC token npm's trusted publisher accepts and holds a PAT with `contents: write`. A compromised or broken plugin release lands directly in the publish path, and the floating `github`/`npm` copies can differ from the ones `semantic-release` pins. The unused changelog plugin also suggests to readers that `CHANGELOG.md` is maintained, which it is not.

## Fix

Delete the `with: extra_plugins:` block from the Semantic Release step. The plugins the config uses already resolve from `semantic-release`'s own dependency tree.

## Resolution
Removed the `with: extra_plugins` block from the Semantic Release step in publish.yml, with a comment explaining why. actionlint and zizmor --pedantic clean.
title: Release job npm-installs three unpinned semantic-release plugins, one of them unused

body:
## Problem

Excess secret exposure. `pr-lint.yml` puts `NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}` in the workflow-level `env:` (line 17), so every step receives it, and re-passes it explicitly to `Simek/yarn-lock-changes` (line 51) and `ivuorinen/actions/pr-lint` (line 58). Neither needs an npm token: the repo has no private dependencies, and `publish.yml` states "npm auth uses Trusted Publishing (OIDC) … so no NPM_TOKEN is needed".

## Evidence

```yaml
# .github/workflows/pr-lint.yml:16-18
env:
  NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
...
      - name: Yarn Lock Changes
        uses: Simek/yarn-lock-changes@59f47ee499424d2c2437c5aebf863b5c6d50a5bc # v0.14.1
        ...
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```

The sibling `base-configs-commitlint/.github/workflows/pr-lint.yml` removed exactly this and documents why: "No workflow-level `env:` either — a secret placed there is handed to every step in the job, including third-party actions that have no use for it."

## Impact

If the `NPM_TOKEN` secret still exists and can publish, any compromise of a third-party action in this job (or of MegaLinter's many bundled tools) can exfiltrate an npm publish credential on every same-repo PR. Fork PRs do not receive secrets, which limits but does not remove the exposure (Renovate/Dependabot branches are same-repo).

## Fix

Remove the workflow-level `env:` block and the `NPM_TOKEN` lines from both steps; pass `token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` via `with:` only. Then delete the `NPM_TOKEN` repository/environment secret if nothing else reads it (publishing uses OIDC).

## Resolution
Removed the workflow-level env block and the NPM_TOKEN lines from both steps in pr-lint.yml; steps keep only GITHUB_TOKEN. Deleting the NPM_TOKEN secret remains the owner's action.
title: NPM_TOKEN is set workflow-wide on pull_request and handed to a third-party action

body:
## Problem

`publish.yml` restores `node_modules` keyed on `hashFiles('.nvmrc', '**/yarn.lock')` and runs `yarn install` only `if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'` (lines 69-81), without `--immutable`. A change to `package.json` that does not change `yarn.lock` keeps the cache key, so the release runs against the previous tree. When the install does run, a manifest/lockfile mismatch is silently re-resolved instead of failing.

## Evidence

```yaml
# .github/workflows/publish.yml:76-81
          key: node-modules-${{ hashFiles('.nvmrc', '**/yarn.lock') }}
      - name: Install Dependencies
        shell: bash
        if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: yarn install
```

This exact pattern shipped a wrong release in the sibling repo: `base-configs-stylelint/.github/workflows/publish.yml:86-93` records that a package.json-only bump "restored the previous node_modules, skipped this step, and released against a dependency tree that no longer matched the manifest. That shipped 1.4.0 -- … cut a minor where 2.0.0's rules say major."

## Impact

semantic-release reads its release rules from `@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config` inside `node_modules`; a stale tree applies the old rules and can cut the wrong version, as already happened in stylelint.

## Fix

Run the install unconditionally and immutably, keeping the cache only as a speed-up:

```yaml
      - name: Install Dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build
```

## Resolution
publish.yml install now runs unconditionally as `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build` (cache kept as a speed-up, key includes .nvmrc).
title: Release installs are skipped on a cache hit and not --immutable, so a stale tree can release

body:
## Problem

Changelog drift. `CHANGELOG.md` says "All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file" and its newest entry is `## [1.0.23] … (2026-06-15)`. The release config no longer writes it: `@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config` 2.x has no `@semantic-release/changelog` or `@semantic-release/git` plugin.

## Evidence

```text
$ git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -- CHANGELOG.md
04757c4 2026-06-15 chore(release): 1.0.23 [skip ci]
$ git tag --sort=-v:refname | head -3
v4.0.2
v4.0.1
v4.0.0
```

Three majors (v2.0.0, v3.0.0, v4.0.0) and their patches are absent. The README's "See [CHANGELOG]" link points to GitHub Releases, which is the maintained source.

## Impact

Anyone reading the file (npm shows it; the repo lists it) concludes the package has not changed since 1.0.23 and misses three breaking releases, including the Node floor raise.

## Fix

Delete `CHANGELOG.md` (release notes live on GitHub Releases, as the README already says), or replace its body with one line pointing at https://github.com/ivuorinen/base-configs/releases.

## Resolution
CHANGELOG.md replaced with a pointer to GitHub Releases stating it is no longer generated.
title: CHANGELOG.md stops at 1.0.23 while releases reached v4.0.2

body:
## Problem

`.github/renovate.json` only extends the shared preset. It lacks the `packageRules` entry that `base-configs-semantic-release` and `base-configs-stylelint` added to give GitHub Actions and pre-commit updates the `actions` scope. Without it Renovate titles a major action bump `chore(deps)!: …`, and `@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config` 2.x maps `{ breaking: true, type: "chore", scope: "deps" }` to `release: "major"`.

## Evidence

History shows the pattern cutting majors: `v1.0.0` here was produced by, among others, `8276507 chore(deps)!: update actions/checkout (v5.0.1 → v6.0.0) (#427)` and `6a7e7c1 chore(deps)!: update actions/setup-node (v5.0.0 → v6.0.0) (#406)`. `base-configs-stylelint/.github/renovate.json` documents the mechanism: "Renovate was otherwise emitting `chore(deps)` for some of these updates, which releases a patch, or `chore(deps)!` for majors".

## Impact

The next major bump of any action (checkout, setup-node, cache) publishes a new major of `@ivuorinen/base-configs` although nothing consumers install changed; consumers pinned to `^4` stop receiving updates until they notice.

## Fix

Add the rule both sibling repos use:

```json
"packageRules": [
  {
    "matchManagers": ["github-actions", "pre-commit"],
    "semanticCommitType": "chore",
    "semanticCommitScope": "actions"
  }
]
```

## Resolution
Added packageRules to .github/renovate.json giving github-actions and pre-commit updates semanticCommitType chore, scope actions.
title: Renovate CI-only major bumps are labelled chore(deps)! and would cut a major release

body:
## Problem

The repo has no `.github/dependabot.yml`, so Dependabot security PRs use the default `chore(deps): bump …` prefix, which the release rules map to a patch. The three unreleased commits since `v4.0.2` change only `yarn.lock`, which reaches no consumer.

## Evidence

```text
$ git log --format='%h %s' v4.0.2..HEAD
6ee9ca2 chore(deps): bump browserslist from 4.28.4 to 4.28.8 (#575)   yarn.lock | 56
cdeafcc chore(deps): bump fast-uri from 3.1.5 to 3.1.6 (#573)         yarn.lock | 6
cf52ed7 chore(deps): bump @humanfs/node from 0.16.7 to 0.16.8 (#574)  yarn.lock | 26
```

`base-configs-semantic-release/.github/dependabot.yml` solves this with `versioning-strategy: lockfile-only` and `commit-message: prefix: "chore(actions)"`.

## Impact

Once the release pipeline is unblocked, v4.0.3 publishes with no consumer-visible change; every future lockfile-only bump repeats that.

## Fix

Add `.github/dependabot.yml` mirroring semantic-release's: `package-ecosystem: npm`, `versioning-strategy: lockfile-only`, `commit-message: { prefix: "chore(actions)" }`.

## Resolution
Added .github/dependabot.yml (npm, versioning-strategy lockfile-only, weekly, cooldown 7 days, commit-message prefix chore(actions)) mirroring base-configs-semantic-release, so lockfile-only bumps no longer cut a patch release.
title: Dependabot lockfile-only bumps are labelled chore(deps) and cut patch releases

body:
## Problem

Dead configuration. `.gitignore` lines 2-15 ignore and re-include `packages/**` config files for a monorepo layout that no longer exists (the configs moved to separate repositories), `.prettierignore` line 2 ignores `/.nx/workspace-data` (no Nx here), and `.yarnclean` is a Yarn 1 `autoclean` file that Yarn 4 does not read.

## Evidence

```text
$ git ls-files | grep -c '^packages/'
0
$ git ls-files | grep -ci nx
0
$ yarn --version
4.18.0
```

`.gitignore:16` ignores all of `.yarn`.

## Impact

Misleads maintainers about the repo layout and tooling; `.yarnclean`'s patterns (e.g. `*.md`, `test`, `docs`) suggest pruning that never happens.

## Fix

Reduce `.gitignore` to `node_modules/` and the Yarn 4 artefacts (`.yarn/cache`, `.yarn/unplugged`, `.yarn/build-state.yml`, `.yarn/install-state.gz`, `.pnp.*`), drop the `/.nx/workspace-data` line from `.prettierignore`, and delete `.yarnclean`.

## Resolution
.gitignore reduced to node_modules and the Yarn 4 artefacts; /.nx line dropped from .prettierignore; .yarnclean removed (git rm).
title: Ignore files and .yarnclean describe a monorepo and Yarn 1 layout that no longer exist

## Problem

Missing information. `.github/SECURITY.md:9`: "If you find a vulnerability, please send me email and I'll fix it as soon as possible." No address, no link to GitHub private vulnerability reporting.

## Evidence

The whole file is 9 lines; `grep -c '@' .github/SECURITY.md` → 0.

## Impact

A reporter has no private channel and may open a public issue instead.

## Fix

Replace the sentence with a concrete channel, e.g. "Report privately via GitHub: Security → Report a vulnerability" (and enable private vulnerability reporting), or give the address.

## Resolution
SECURITY.md now points to https://github.com/ivuorinen/base-configs/security/advisories/new; private vulnerability reporting is enabled on this repo (gh api .../private-vulnerability-reporting → enabled: true).
title: SECURITY.md asks reporters to email but gives no address

body:
## Problem

Unused dev dependencies. `package.json` declares `"@types/node": "^26.0.0"` (line 61) and `"typescript": "^6.0.3"` (line 64), and `.yarnrc.yml:10-13` extends `@commitlint/load` with `typescript`/`@types/node`. The repo contains no TypeScript, never runs `tsc`, and `@commitlint/load` is no longer in the tree.

## Evidence

Manifest: `package.json:61`, `package.json:64` (devDependencies). Lockfile: both resolved (`typescript@patch:typescript@npm%3A6.0.3`), while `grep -c '^"@commitlint/load@' yarn.lock` → `0`. Usage scan: `git ls-files | grep -cE '\.(ts|mts|cts|tsx)$'` → `0`; no `tsc`/`typescript` reference in `package.json` scripts, workflows or `eslint.config.mjs`. The only remaining consumer, `eslint-plugin-n`'s `lib/util/get-full-type-name.js`, loads `typescript` inside `try { … } catch { return null }`, and linting works with it unresolvable (verified in `base-configs-eslint`).

## Impact

Roughly 20 MB of compiler plus type definitions installed on every clone and CI run for no effect, and a `packageExtensions` entry that reads as if commitlint needed patching here.

## Fix

Remove both devDependencies and the `'@commitlint/load@*'` block from `.yarnrc.yml` (keep the `eslint-plugin-n` block only if you want type-aware `n/no-sync`, which nothing here uses — otherwise drop it too), then `yarn install`. Removal is behavior-affecting in principle: confirm `yarn eslint:report` still passes before committing.

## Resolution
Owner-approved removal: typescript and @types/node devDependencies and both packageExtensions blocks (@commitlint/load, eslint-plugin-n) removed from package.json/.yarnrc.yml. `yarn eslint:report`, `yarn prettier:report` pass; immutable install passes. typescript still resolves transitively (6.0.3 via @ivuorinen/eslint-config 1.2.3), not as a declared dependency.
title: typescript and @types/node devDependencies and the @commitlint/load packageExtension serve nothing

## Problem

The repo's own `markdownlint:report` script exits 1 on a clean `main`: `CLAUDE.md` violates MD060 (table pipe spacing), MD013 (lines over 200) and blank-line rules under the repo's `.markdownlint.json`. Found during the fix pass, not the audit pass — the conventions sweep ran `pre-commit --all-files` in the package repos, and this repo has no pre-commit config.

## Evidence

`git show HEAD:CLAUDE.md | markdownlint --stdin -c .markdownlint.json` → 26 errors (e.g. `14:1 MD060/table-column-style`, `28:201 MD013/line-length`); README.md, CHANGELOG.md and SECURITY.md report 0.

## Impact

`yarn fix` / `markdownlint:report`, which CLAUDE.md itself lists as the lint commands, fail on every run, so a real Markdown regression is indistinguishable from the standing failures.

## Fix

Run `markdownlint --fix CLAUDE.md` (fixes table spacing and blank lines) and wrap the remaining lines over 200 characters.

## Resolution
markdownlint --fix CLAUDE.md applied table spacing and blank-line fixes; four lines over 200 characters wrapped by hand. yarn markdownlint:report and yarn prettier:report exit 0. docs/audit/ added to .markdownlintignore (generated findings store), as base-configs-commitlint does.
title: yarn markdownlint:report fails on main: CLAUDE.md has 26 markdownlint errors

## Problem

Non-gating check. `pr-lint.yml` (PR Lint), `pr.yml` and `codeql.yml` run on `pull_request` and read as merge gates, but `main`'s branch protection lists no required status checks and there are no rulesets. The repository also has `allow_auto_merge: true`.

## Evidence

Verified with the GitHub API (authenticated):

```text
$ gh api repos/ivuorinen/base-configs/branches/main/protection
required_status_checks: none | enforce_admins: false
$ gh api repos/ivuorinen/base-configs/rules/branches/main
[]
$ gh api repos/ivuorinen/base-configs --jq .allow_auto_merge
true
```

`main` currently carries failing runs: `gh api repos/ivuorinen/base-configs/commits/main/check-runs` → `Lint=failure`, `Dependabot=failure`.

## Impact

Any PR — including bot PRs with auto-merge enabled — merges regardless of lint, CodeQL or lockfile results. The advisory-laden lockfile that now blocks publishing merged this way.

## Fix

Add a ruleset (or branch-protection rule) on `main` requiring the check contexts `PR Lint` and `Analyze (javascript)`. Verify afterwards with:

```sh
gh api repos/ivuorinen/base-configs/rules/branches/main --jq '.[] | select(.type=="required_status_checks")'
```

## Resolution
ruleset 'main checks' (24025505) added on 2026-09-26: PR Lint, Analyze (javascript); verified via rules/branches/main
title: No PR check is required and auto-merge is on, so red PRs merge (verified)

body:
## Problem

The non-releasing rule in `.github/renovate.json` matches only `"matchManagers": ["github-actions", "pre-commit"]`, and the major-prefix rule only `["pre-commit"]`. Renovate's `nvm` manager, which updates `.nvmrc`, matches neither. `.nvmrc` is not in `package.json` `files`, and the workflows read it only through `node-version-file`, so a Node bump there never reaches consumers. Renovate still titles it with the preset default scope `deps`.

## Evidence

- Shared preset `github>ivuorinen/renovate-config` sets `semanticCommitScope: "actions"` only for `matchManagers: ["github-actions"]`, and sets `commitMessagePrefix: "chore(deps)!: "` on every `major` update. Its `chore(actions): ` override for majors covers github-actions only.
- Shared release rules (`@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config` 3.0.0 `index.cjs:11-13`): `chore(deps)` gives a patch, breaking `chore(deps)` gives a major, and `chore(actions)` gives no release.
- Observed: ivuorinen/base-configs#577 and ivuorinen/base-configs-commitlint#196 (branch `renovate/node-26.x`, which changes only `.nvmrc`). Renovate titled both `chore(deps): update node.js (…)`, including force-pushes made after the actions/devDependencies rule landed (#578 / #201). The maintainer renamed both to `chore(actions): …` by hand before merging (PR timeline `renamed` events by the maintainer).

## Impact

Unless someone retitles the PR, every Node minor or patch bump merges as `chore(deps)` and publishes a needless patch release. In config-checker, each release then fans out into Renovate bumps across every @ivuorinen package. A Node major (for example 26 → 28) arrives as `chore(deps)!:` and publishes a **major** release of the package, even though consumers see no change.

## Fix

Add `"nvm"` to both manager lists, and update the first rule's description so it names `.nvmrc` as well:

```json
"matchManagers": ["github-actions", "nvm", "pre-commit"],
…
"matchManagers": ["nvm", "pre-commit"],
"matchUpdateTypes": ["major"],
"commitMessagePrefix": "chore(actions): "
```

The better fix is to make the same change once in the shared `ivuorinen/renovate-config` preset, next to its github-actions major rule, so all nine repos pick it up.

## Resolution
Fixed in the shared preset, ivuorinen/renovate-config#114 (merged as 503bbff): nvm (.nvmrc) and pre-commit updates get the literal prefix "chore(tooling): " and devDependencies/require-dev get "chore(dev-deps): " for every update type, so none carries the global "chore(deps)!: " major marker; "actions" stays reserved for github-actions. @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config releases on the deps scope only, so tooling and dev-deps commits cut no release (checked through commit-analyzer). ivuorinen/base-configs#586 then removed every local scope, prefix and group rule from this repo's .github/renovate.json; only the conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits <10 hold remains.
title: Renovate .nvmrc (nvm manager) updates are titled chore(deps) and release the package

body:
## Problem

The third packageRule (`matchManagers: ["pre-commit"]`, `matchUpdateTypes: ["major"]`) and the `pre-commit` entry in the first rule's `matchManagers` target a manager with no input in this repo. base-configs has no `.pre-commit-config.yaml`; it runs its hooks through `simple-git-hooks` in `package.json`. The rules came over from the sibling repos, where pre-commit does exist.

## Evidence

- `.github/renovate.json:34-35`: `"matchManagers": ["pre-commit"], "matchUpdateTypes": ["major"]`
- The repo root has no `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (the other eight repos all have one). `package.json` declares `simple-git-hooks`.

## Impact

The rules never fire, so their descriptions ("so without this a hook major still arrives as 'chore(deps)!: '…") describe a risk this repo does not have. The result is dead configuration that someone has to keep in sync whenever the rule set changes, as the fix for the nvm-manager finding will require.

## Fix

Drop the third packageRule and remove `"pre-commit"` from the first rule's `matchManagers`, adjusting its description. If the rules stay deliberately for parity with the sibling repos, add a description line that says so.

## Resolution
The pre-commit rules are gone: ivuorinen/base-configs#586 reduced .github/renovate.json to the conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits <10 hold. Scope and prefix handling for every manager, pre-commit included, now lives in the shared preset (ivuorinen/renovate-config#114).
title: renovate.json pre-commit rules match nothing: base-configs has no .pre-commit-config.yaml
